Amounts in the statement above are presented in millions.

NOTE 2 - DISCONTINUED OPERATIONS AND RECAST OF PRIOR PERIODS
On June 30, 2025 the Company completed the sale of its Meridian test-systems business. The
business is presented as a discontinued operation for all periods presented, and the
consolidated statements of operations above have been recast accordingly. Amounts presented
for 2024 in this report are therefore not the amounts as originally reported in the Company's
Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2024: total revenue for 2024
was 1,489.0 as originally reported and 1,296.0 as recast, and operating income for 2024 was
291.0 as originally reported and 248.0 as recast. Net income for 2024 is unchanged at 214.0,
because the recast reclassifies results between continuing and discontinued operations without
changing the total.

NOTE 14 - NONCONTROLLING INTERESTS
The Company consolidates Calderwood Photonics KK, in which it holds a 74% economic interest.
The remaining interest is presented as a noncontrolling interest, and the earnings
attributable to it are deducted in arriving at net income attributable to Calderwood Systems,
Inc. Earnings per share is computed on net income attributable to Calderwood Systems, Inc.
